page.overview:
Who is Ariadni Athar?

Ariadni Athar was the heiress of House Athar.

Ariadni Athar was approached by the Prisoner at The Salusan Bull in Arrakeen. She told them that it was a terrible time and asked them to leave, but they informed her that her house's majordomo had sent them to assist in the matter of a dress. She then asked them to stay and explained that it was more than a matter of pretty fabrics, for her family had worked hard to raise their status and their efforts would suffer great damage if she arrived to the banquet wearing the same dress as Ariste Atreides. She accepted their offer of aid to acquire the dress by any means necessary. She sent them to her tailor to ensure that the dress was delivered in time for the banquet.
